name: warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-never-activatable-on-later-turn
notes: Warrior of the Fae Realm (eRcqucBKhX): "As long as you control CARDNAME, you may activate the banished card on a later turn." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): the banished card is tagged with the _warriorFaeRealm turn effect, but the end-of-turn cleanup of the banish zone (Custom/GameLogic.php, "Clear TurnEffects from the expiring player's banish zone") keeps only '_seethingIntercession' and strips every other tag, so by the time a "later turn" arrives the tag is gone and ActionMap("myBanish") ignores the click. Player 1 plays the Warrior and banishes the Striking Tides, both players pass a turn, and on player 1's next turn clicking the banished card does nothing: no payment is requested and it stays in banishment. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin this (a working implementation would start the activation and ask for payment).

rulesClauses: As long as you control Warrior of the Fae Realm, you may activate the banished card on a later turn.

engineBug.summary: The banished Sword attack can never be activated on a later turn: the _warriorFaeRealm tag added to the banished card is stripped by the end-of-turn cleanup of the banish zone, so on the next turn the ActionMap 'myBanish' branch ignores the click. Confirmed live: the replayed state shows the tag present after the On Enter and gone after the turn change; the end-of-turn cleanup (Custom/GameLogic.php, 'Clear TurnEffects from the expiring player's banish zone') retains only '_seethingIntercession'.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php end-of-turn banish-zone TurnEffects cleanup (retains only _seethingIntercession) vs the _warriorFaeRealm tag set by the generated enterAbilities['eRcqucBKhX:0'] handler
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live with a temporary file trace (restored afterwards): the end-of-turn banish cleanup logged effectsBefore=["_warriorFaeRealm"] for the Striking Tides, and the later-turn myBanish click then logged tags=[] with the Warrior on the field. Break/restore: retaining _warriorFaeRealm in that cleanup (together with a per-turn marker for the same-turn bug) flipped both Warrior guard fixtures red; restored, shasums verified.
